D/ IMP C M AVR SEV ALEXAND AVG ; R/ PVDICITIA

Silver coin. Denarius of Severus Alexander (222-235), RIC vol. 4 part 2 page 94 no. 307, 'hybrid' base denarius. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate draped right. Obverse inscription: IMP C M AVR SEV ALEXAND AVG. Reverse description: Pudicitia seated left cradling sceptre. Reverse inscription: PVDICITIA. Diameter: 19.4mm, Weight: 2.44gms, die axis: 6
